patterns: APPSC asks direct definitions: T-bill maturities (91, 182, 364 days), gilt-edged market = Treasury Bills + government bonds.
Other PSCs/UPSC repeat: CP = short-term unsecured note for corporates, call money = inter-bank, CBLO = money market, T-bills issued at discount by RBI.
Classification traps: which markets are capital vs money market (bond and stock = capital; call and T-bill = money).
Newer UPSC items: AIF categories (hedge funds, venture capital), sustainability bond, InvITs.
App MCQs are well aligned but add 2025-26 data points (household equity share, Budget 2026-27, SEBI accredited-investor AIF) beyond PYQ depth.
